we show how to extend the seam carving operator to 3D space-time volumes, we present an improved energy criterion and we present a graph cuts implementation of the improved seam carving algorithm

The main takeaway from our work is that
by replacing the dynamic programming method used in seam carving with graph cut, the seam carving operator becomes suitable for 3 dimensional space time volumes.
graph cuts are a powerful tool that can be used to extend image processing techniques to the video domain.
by replacing dynamic programming with graph cuts we gain the ability to remove 2D seams in 3D volumes and thus, to retarget videos.
